## Route interface

A route as `g.route()` makes it: how rows of base `B` reach provider `P`<!-- -->. It declares nothing on its own: `g.graph(...routes)` takes it, and the graph's type then knows that `P` is read from `B`<!-- -->, so a run or a read that asks `P` for rows of another entity does not compile.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Route<B extends string, P extends ProviderBase> 
```
